dataset.title: Weather rows
dataset.description: One row per place. Paid rows carry the coordinates, the units, the hourly series and the daily high and low; rows that could not be read carry status, reason and billable false, so the free rows have no data fields to fill.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Counters for the run: locationsRequested, locationsDelivered, chargedEvents, chargeUncertain, deliveredUnverified, byStatus, counterMismatch, stopReason, the source with its CC-BY attribution, and the free statuses NOT_CHECKED_LIMIT, NOT_CHECKED_CAP, NOT_CHECKED_TIME, NOT_CHECKED_BILLING, NOT_CHECKED_ERROR.
